exposure: time of initiation of breast feeding after birth
finding: Asymptomatic hypoglycemia occurred in about 10% of healthy, full-term neonates, with primiparity and delayed initiation of breast feeding > 1 hour noted as additional risk factors.
mod_finding: Neonates born to primiparous mothers and/or who had delayed initiation of breastfeeding (>1 hour after birth) were more likely to experience hypoglycemia.
